headings.usage: All section headers, dashboard metrics, and hero titles. MUST use uppercase for top-level headers.

body.usage: General text, inputs, data tables, and tooltips.

mono.usage: IDs, technical data, and small labels.

primary.description: Electric Blaze - Use for primary CTAs and active states.

secondary.description: Volt Blue - Use for progress bars, success states, and information.

dashboard.rule: Every pixel utilized. Use h-full on children. No jagged bottoms.

marketing_landing.rule: Asymmetry creates tension. Leave negative space.

buttons.hover: Scale 105% or brightness-110. No shadow on dark mode.

inputs.style: h-12 bg-transparent border-b-2 border-neutral-700 focus:border-primary rounded-none px-0 transition-all
inputs.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-500

navigation.sidebar: Fixed left, w-64, bg-background border-r border-border. Active item needs glowing left border.
navigation.topbar: Sticky top, glassmorphism, z-50. Flex distinct between global search and user profile.

gradients.rule: No full-screen gradients. Use subtle spot glows (radial-gradient) behind key elements.

micro_interactions.loading: Use skeleton loaders with shimmering effect, never generic spinners for main content.

hero_background.usage: Landing page hero, opacity 40% with black overlay.

workout_section.usage: Workouts page header or card background.

trainer_profile.usage: Trainer dashboard profile, member detail view.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Consistent sizing (w-5 h-5 for UI, w-8 h-8 for features).

universal_guidelines: You have .js files not .tsx files. Write all components in .jsx/.js format.
Do NOT use gradients for text or borders unless explicitly for a 'Gold' member tier.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating elements.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
NEVER use standard browser alerts. Use 'sonner' for toasts.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute (kebab-case).
Mobile-First: Always start with grid-cols-1 and expand.
Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text. Use APCA standards.
accessibility_checklist: All images must have alt text.
Inputs must have associated labels (visible or aria-label).
Focus states must be visible (ring-2 ring-primary).
Color is not the only means of conveying information (use icons/text labels too).
